description: Which owner has paid for the most treatments on his or her dogs? List the owner id and last name.

metadata.original_question: Which owner has paid for the most treatments on his or her dogs? List the owner id and last name.
metadata.query: SELECT T1.owner_id ,  T1.last_name FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id JOIN Treatments AS T3 ON T2.dog_id  =  T3.dog_id GROUP BY T1.owner_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

utterance: map treatment_types data to treatments data
description: What is the description of the treatment type that costs the least money in total?

metadata.original_question: What is the description of the treatment type that costs the least money in total?
metadata.query: SELECT T1.treatment_type_description FROM Treatment_types AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.treatment_type_code  =  T2.treatment_type_code GROUP BY T1.treatment_type_code ORDER BY sum(cost_of_treatment) ASC LIMIT 1

utterance: map singer data to song data
description: Show distinct names of singers that have songs with sales more than 300000.

metadata.original_question: Show distinct names of singers that have songs with sales more than 300000.
metadata.query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Name FROM singer AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID  =  T2.Singer_ID WHERE T2.Sales  >  300000

description: What is the feature type name of feature AirCon?

metadata.original_question: What is the feature type name of feature AirCon?
metadata.query: SELECT T2.feature_type_name FROM Other_Available_Features AS T1 JOIN Ref_Feature_Types AS T2 ON T1.feature_type_code  =  T2.feature_type_code WHERE T1.feature_name  =  "AirCon"

metadata.query: SELECT T2.property_type_description FROM Properties AS T1 JOIN Ref_Property_Types AS T2 ON T1.property_type_code  =  T2.property_type_code GROUP BY T1.property_type_code
